notes: Card: ' =' x5, '=' x2, ' equal' x2, '=>', ' exponential' (equations), all in worked maths problems; very sparse (0.007% of tokens reach 0.1 of max). Probes: '4/x = 8/10' 0.88, '2w + 5 = 17 …' 0.73, 'angles are equal, or 3x = 60' 0.46, '3/4 = 15/g' 0.36, 'momentum to equal 2mv' 0.36, 'Solving exponential equations' 0.23; Python 'x = 5' 0.03, 'if a == b' 0.04, 'equal before the law' 0.02, prices 0.02. The peak token is sometimes the number just after the '='. The - pole is unrelated in form (Python 'else:' + newline).
